get_running_jobs: get running jobs from the database and kill completed or zombie processes
get_process_status: get the status of a process by its PID using psutil
kill_process_by_pid: kill a process by sending SIGTERM to its PID
token_verification: verify a Hugging Face token and retrieve user information from the API
get_user_and_orgs: get the username and associated organizations from a Hugging Face user token
